verdict.rationale: Buzz has no dedicated sandbox or test mode, but because it is self-hostable you can stand up an isolated non-production instance. The Helm chart documents a separate "Quickstart (eval)" profile with its own in-cluster Postgres, Redis and MinIO and auto-generated secrets, distinct from the production profile, and the compose bundle and chart need no external services. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment or test-mode API for agents, seeded or mock data tooling, guidance on keeping test agents and keys away from production relays, and independent hands-on corroboration.
